summary: The affiliate networks are focused on measurement: CJ is hosting a PI Live panel on incrementality testing with QVC, Dell and Cardlytics, and Rakuten won three Global Performance Marketing Awards, including Best Measurement & Incrementality Strategy with H&M.
Partnerize argues the click mattered because it was the infrastructure linking discovery to revenue, and asks what comes next as how people shop changes.
Rakuten's DealMaker Europe is returning to London. The retailers and bookstores were otherwise quiet (only general brand posts).

items.title: Rakuten Advertising wins three Global Performance Marketing Awards
items.why: Golds with Emirates (Best Travel, Leisure & Experience Campaign), H&M (Best Measurement & Incrementality Strategy) and for its Detect compliance offering.

items.title: DealMaker Europe returns to Convene Sancroft, London
items.why: Rakuten's brand and publisher networking event is coming back to London.

items.title: CJ at PI Live: QVC, Dell and Cardlytics on testing and incrementality
items.why: Networks keep pushing measurement 'beyond traditional attribution', meaning proving a partner actually added sales rather than just getting the last click.

items.title: Partnerize: the click built modern commerce because it was infrastructure
items.why: A partner network openly asking what replaces the click as the link between discovery and sales, the same question behind today's AI search and publisher traffic stories.
